title: 7 Things a Godly Man Does in the First Minute After He's Wrong
caption:
7 things a godly man does in the first minute after he's wrong.

He closes his mouth, says the actual word, drops the "but," names the damage, lets the other man answer in his own time, tells God first, and fixes one small thing today.

Hard on his own sin, gentle with everyone else.

#faith #humility #godlymen #christianman #manofgod #accountability
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
